description:
Archival release of the code and final clean supplementary materials accompanying the accepted manuscript “Evo2VED: a database of DNA large language model-derived scores for variant interpretation” (Nucleic Acids Research; manuscript NAR-02968-Data-E-2026.R1, accepted 5 October 2026).

The repository contains the database construction pipeline, analysis and figure scripts, and Datasette web application code. The supplementary files in docs/supplementary/ are Evo2VED_Supplementary_Tables.xlsx (Content and Tables S1–S24) and Evo2VED_Supplementary_Material.docx (final clean version without tracked revisions, comments, or highlighting). These two files were provided by the corresponding author for final archival deposition.

The live database is available at https://dnallmved.org/. The genome-wide variant database and other externally distributed datasets are not included in this code archive. The GitHub repository remains available for ongoing development at https://github.com/huthvincent/DNA-LLM-VED.
